analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported resilient Q1 FY27 financial performance despite a challenging operating environment marked by global supply-side disruptions, raw material inflation, and weather uncertainties. Quarterly revenue reached ₹ 532 crore (up 35% year-on-year) and EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore (up 36% year-on-year), supported by disciplined cost management, diversified sourcing, and the introduction of new complex fertilizer variants. Management remains confident about capacity ramp-ups and maintaining strong operational performance for the remainder of FY27 as raw material availability has improved. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported robust operational and financial momentum for the first quarter of FY27, driven by expanded capacities at Meghnagar and disciplined cost control. Quarterly revenue from operations grew 34.58% year-on-year to ₹532.3 crore, and Profit After Tax increased 53.88% year-on-year to ₹47.06 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a top-line increase of approximately Rs. 500 crore in FY27.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer offtake accelerated across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season following improved rainfall.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry due to comfortable domestic stock levels and a favourable monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects fertilizer demand to remain stable due to the essential nature of agriculture.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved or disclosed.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: Management reported that expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: Total fertilizer capacity stands at 615,000 MTPA.
Management stated there are no further expansion plans currently.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore following the commissioning of new capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000 to ₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% year-on-year to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects margin pressure in the first quarter due to rising input costs.
margins_costs.quote: While there may be some margin pressure in the first quarter, we expect margins to stabilize in the later part of the year as cost increases are passed on.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects to maintain EBITDA of around Rs. 6,000 per ton for NPK, with a potential variance of 3% to 4%.
margins_costs.quote: For NPK, EBITDA of around Rs.6,000 per ton may vary slightly, within a range of approximately ±3% to 4%.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT with an additional 165,000 MT, taking total capacity to 495,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company achieved 43% capacity utilization of the NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production for the quarter reached 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved record utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with some units operating above 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The recent capacity expansion was funded through a mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping lane uncertainties introduced considerable uncertainty across global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal by the end of June, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year.
risks_headwinds.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that factors causing actual results to differ materially include market conditions, regulatory changes, competitive pressures, and technological advancements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Factors that could cause actual results to differ materially include market conditions, regulatory changes, competitive pressures, and technological advancements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties as key risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia capacity from the SECI agreement will start in 2 years in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expressed confidence in building on current momentum through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the benefits of the new capacity expansion to reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in three years.
management_commitments.quote: As per the contract, the green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in the third year, so we expect supply after approximately three years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
